### But Lord, I Can't DO That!
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/but-lord-i-can-t-do-that-encouragement-for-today-march-3-2016.html
Passage: Exodus 4:10
Points:
- Personal insecurities frequently hinder believers from stepping into the tasks God assigns them.
- Moses doubted his fitness for leadership because he fixated on his lack of speaking eloquence.
- Questioning whether we have what it takes ultimately doubts God's intentional design and creative abilities.
- Believers must choose to let God's perfection override feelings of personal inadequacy and simply obey.

### Why Disabilities?
Author: David Murray
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/why-disabilities
Passage: Exodus 4:11
Points:
- Physical impairments serve as visible reminders of humanity's deeper, universal spiritual brokenness after the Fall.
- God's image and grace often shine brightly through the genuine joy and sincerity of disabled individuals.
- Jesus modeled God's heart by extending tender compassion, healing, and salvation to those with disabilities.
- The sacrificial love demonstrated by caregivers reflects humanity at its finest and glorifies God.
